name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have key : ∀ e L, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars e ⊆ L →
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) e) ⊆ L ++ [h1] := by
    intro e L h
    induction e with
    | const | bvar | op | fvar => exact List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h
    | abs _ _ _ ih => exact ih h
    | eq _ _ _ ih1 ih2 | quant _ _ _ _ _ ih1 ih2 =>
        simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.append_subset] at h
        exact List.append_subset.mpr ⟨ih1 h.1, ih2 h.2⟩
    | ite _ _ _ _ ih1 ih2 ih3 =>
        simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.append_subset] at h
        exact List.append_subset.mpr ⟨List.append_subset.mpr ⟨ih1 h.1.1, ih2 h.1.2⟩, ih3 h.2⟩
    | app _ e1 e2 ih1 ih2 =>
        dsimp only [substOld]
        · split
          · split
            · exact List.subset_append_right _ _
            · exact List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h
          · exact List.append_subset.mpr
              ⟨ih1 (List.append_subset.mp h).1, ih2 (List.append_subset.mp h).2⟩
  exact key post _ (List.Subset.refl _)

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have hap {a b c d : List Expression.Ident} : a ⊆ c → b ⊆ d → a ++ b ⊆ c ++ d :=
    fun h1 h2 => List.Subset.app (List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h1)
      (List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ h2)
  intro h
  induction h with
  | abs => assumption
  | quant | eq => apply hap <;> assumption
  | ite =>
      apply hap
      apply hap <;> assumption
      assumption
  | app =>
      unfold extractOldExprVars
      split
      exact List.Subset.refl _
      exact List.nil_subset _
      apply hap <;> assumption
  | _ => exact List.nil_subset _

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro Hup Hinit
  have Hl := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  have Hl' := InitStatesLength Hinit
  exact ⟨_, ⟨rfl, updatedStatesInit Hl' (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup)
      (InitStatesNodup Hinit), by
    rewrite [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
    unfold updatedStates
    rewrite [updatedStatesComm (by rewrite [List.unzip_zip Hl, List.unzip_zip Hl']; exact fun _ hx hx' => by simpa [InitStatesNotDefined Hinit _ hx'] using UpdateStatesDefined Hup _ hx)]
    exact updatedStatesUpdate Hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup))⟩⟩

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx0
  have hi : Continuous (⟪f ·, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := by fun_prop
  have h0 : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (Ne.symm (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx0))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hpos⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hi.continuousAt h0)
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  exact ne_of_gt ((φ.continuous.mul hi).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right
      (fun x => if h : φ x = 0 then by simp [h]
        else mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hpos x (φ.support_eq ▸ Function.mem_support.mpr h)).le)
      (mul_ne_zero (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)).ne' h0.ne'))
    ((integral_congr_ae (ae_of_all _ fun _ => (inner_smul_right' _ _ _).symm)).trans
      (hg _ (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)))

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)
  have hdJ : Differentiable ℝ J := hJ.differentiable (by simp)
  have hc : 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) = 𝓕.c ^ 2 := by rw [mul_comm, FreeSpace.c_sq]
  have he : 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ := by rw [FreeSpace.c_sq]; simp [mul_comm, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm]
  let B : Fin d → Time → Space d → ℝ := fun j s y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)
  have hB : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 ↿ (B j) := fun j => magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ hA3 (j, i)
  let E : Fin d → Space d → ℝ := fun k y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y k
  have hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (E j) := fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space hA3 t
  let F : Time → ℝ := fun s => ∑ j, ∂[j] (B j s) x
  let G : Time → ℝ := fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i
  have hF : Differentiable ℝ F :=
    Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (hB j) x
  have hG : Differentiable ℝ G :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time hdJ x i
  have h1 : ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) = fun s => 𝓕.c ^ 2 * F s - 𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * G s := by
    funext s
    rw [← he, ← hc]
    exact (Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA2 x) s).trans
      (time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h s x i)
  have h2 : ∂ₜ (fun s => 𝓕.c ^ 2 * F s - 𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * G s) t
      = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∂ₜ F t - 𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ G t := by
    rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hF.differentiableAt.const_mul _)
      (hG.differentiableAt.const_mul _),
      fderiv_const_mul hF.differentiableAt _, fderiv_const_mul hG.differentiableAt _]
    simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Time.deriv_eq]
  have h3 : ∂ₜ F t = ∑ j, ∂[j] (fun y => ∂ₜ (B j · y) t) x :=
    (Time.deriv_fun_sum Finset.univ (fun j s => ∂[j] (B j s) x)
      (fun j _ => (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (hB j) x).differentiableAt)).trans
      (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hB j) t x)
  have h4 : ∑ j, ∂[j] (fun y => ∂ₜ (B j · y) t) x = ∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[j] (E i) - ∂[i] (E j)) x :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => congrArg (fun f => ∂[j] f x)
      (funext fun y => time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A hA2 t y j i)
  have h5 : ∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[j] (E i) - ∂[i] (E j)) x
      = ∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[j] (E i)) x - ∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[i] (E j)) x := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ =>
      congrFun (Space.deriv_sub _ _ (Space.deriv_differentiable (hE i) j)
        (Space.deriv_differentiable (hE j) i)) x
  have h6 : ∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[i] (E j)) x = ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (E j) y) x := by
    refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => congrFun (Space.deriv_commute _ (hE j)) x).trans ?_
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
      fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (Space.deriv_differentiable (hE j) j).differentiableAt]
    simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
  have h7 : ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (E j) y) x
      = 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (fun y => J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y) x := by
    have hd : (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (E j) y) = (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) • (fun y => J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y) := by
      funext y
      show (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) y = (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y
      rw [((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1, div_eq_mul_inv]
      ring
    rw [hd, Space.deriv_const_smul (1 / 𝓕.ε₀)
      (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hdJ t),
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7, ← he]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  refine Submodule.span_induction₂ (R := ℂ) (s := Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)
    (t := Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)
    (p := fun x y _ _ => ι 𝓣ᶠ(x * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * y) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(x * y)))
    ?mem ?zl ?zr ?al ?ar ?sl ?sr (Basis.mem_span _ a) (Basis.mem_span _ b)
  · intro x y hx hy
    obtain ⟨φs', rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨φs, rfl⟩ := hy
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul]
    let k := 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ)
    let A := crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs)
    let l := List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)
    let t := List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c) l
    let f := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'
    let g := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs
    let u := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) l
    calc _
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
          crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) • k •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
        conv_lhs =>
          rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
            superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
        rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
        module
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) - k •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
        rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
        module
      _ = A • (ι (ofCrAnListF t) * ι (ofCrAnListF f) * ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) *
            ι (ofCrAnListF g) * ι (ofCrAnListF u) -
            k • ι (ofCrAnListF t) * ι (ofCrAnListF f) * ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) *
            ι (ofCrAnListF g) * ι (ofCrAnListF u)) := by
        have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
        rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
        have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
        rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by simp, h2]
        repeat rw [ofCrAnListF_append]
        simp only [map_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
        rfl
      _ = A • (ι (ofCrAnListF t) * ι (ofCrAnListF f) *
            (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - k • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) *
            ι (ofCrAnListF g) * ι (ofCrAnListF u)) := by
        simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
      _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) • (ι (ofCrAnListF t) * ι (ofCrAnListF f) *
          ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ι (ofCrAnListF g) * ι (ofCrAnListF u)) := by
        congr
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
        simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
          map_sub, map_smul]
        rfl
    rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
    repeat rw [mul_assoc]
    rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
      ← ofCrAnListF_append]
    have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
    simp only [ List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h1 ⊢
    rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
    by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by grind only),
        ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
      simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
  · intros; simp only [zero_mul, mul_zero, map_zero]
  · intros; simp only [zero_mul, mul_zero, map_zero]
  · intros; simp only [add_mul, mul_add, map_add, *]
  · intros; simp only [add_mul, mul_add, map_add, *]
  · intros; simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, *]
  · intros; simp only [Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, *]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => cases mem
  case sub ih => exact ih rfl
  case abs L h _ => left; exact .abs (Typing.abs L h).wf.2.1
  case tabs L h _ => left; exact .tabs (Typing.tabs L h).wf.2.1
  case inl ih | inr ih =>
    obtain (val | ⟨_, h⟩) := ih rfl
    · left; constructor; exact val
    · right; constructor; constructor; assumption
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    obtain (val | ⟨_, h⟩) := ih_l rfl
    · obtain (val₂ | ⟨_, h⟩) := ih_r rfl
      · obtain ⟨_, u, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val
        exact ⟨_, .abs val.lc val₂⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ val h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
  case tapp der sub ih =>
    right
    have w := (Sub.wf _ _ _ sub).2.1.lc
    obtain (val | ⟨_, h⟩) := ih rfl
    · obtain ⟨_, u, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
      exact ⟨_, .tabs val.lc w⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp w h⟩
  case let' L der h ih _ =>
    right
    have B := (Term.body_let.1 (Typing.let' L der h).wf.2.1).2
    obtain (val | ⟨_, h₂⟩) := ih rfl
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body val B⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind h₂ B⟩
  case case L der h₂ h₃ ih _ _ =>
    right
    have b := (Term.body_case.1 (Typing.case L der h₂ h₃).wf.2.1).2
    obtain (val | ⟨_, h⟩) := ih rfl
    · obtain ⟨u, rfl | rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
      · exact ⟨_, .case_inl (by cases val; assumption) b.1 b.2⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .case_inr (by cases val; assumption) b.1 b.2⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case h b.1 b.2⟩

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h₁ h₂
  have := h₁
  cases h₁
  · exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case red_I.refl | red_K.refl | red_S.refl | par.refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, this⟩
  case red_I.red_I | red_K.red_K | red_S.red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_I.par hc ha => cases hc; exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par hk _ => obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ hk; exact ⟨_, hy, .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par hs hc =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hs
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hc) (.par hy hc), .red_S ..⟩
  case par.red_I hc ha => cases hc; exact ⟨_, .red_I _, ha⟩
  case par.red_K _ hk => obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ hk; exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hy⟩
  case par.red_S hc _ _ hs =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hs
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hx hc) (.par hy hc)⟩
  case par.par ha hb _ _ ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine HomBisimilarity.symm_simulation ▸ ⟨_, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_, ?_⟩
  constructor
  rintro _ _ (h|h)
  exact .choice h.symm
  exact .bisim h.symm
  rintro a b (hpq|hpq) μ c htr
  cases htr
  · rename_i htr
    exact (hpq.follow_fst htr).imp fun _ => And.imp Tr.choiceL ChoiceBisim.bisim
  · rename_i htr
    exact ⟨c, Tr.choiceR htr, .bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl c)⟩
  exact (hpq.follow_fst htr).imp fun _ => .imp_right ChoiceBisim.bisim

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let ji : Fin (ℓ + 1) := ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  let jir : Fin r := ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i⟩
  let jsr : Fin r := ⟨i.val + steps, fin_ℓ_steps_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i steps h_i_add_steps⟩
  let C_i := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ji
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let d_is := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_one i steps h_i_add_steps⟩
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ji
  have h1 : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_is - 1 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have hb : ∀ t a b : ℕ, a + b ≤ t → t - (a + b) + b = t - a := by
    omega
  have e1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - ↑i :=
    hb _ _ _ (Nat.le_trans h_i_add_steps (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))
  have e2 : ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ - ↑i := hb _ _ _ h_i_add_steps
  have h2 : (d_is - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [d_is, d_i, BBF_CodeDistance]
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add, e1, e2]
  have h_fin : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← h2]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (Nat.zero_le _)
  have h_pos : 0 < d_i := Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.zero_le _)
  obtain ⟨g', hg', hgd⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i,
      d_fw = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr ⟨(0 : C_i), Set.mem_univ _⟩)
    exact ⟨g, g.property, hg.symm⟩
  have h_count : hammingDist f g' ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    let D := ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate jir)
    let Ds := ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate jsr)
    let Y : Set Ds := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    haveI := Fintype.ofFinite Y
    let Δ : Finset D := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x)
    let iq : D → Ds := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
    let kOf : D → Fin (2 ^ steps) :=
      pointToIterateQuotientIndex 𝔽q β (i := ji) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps)
    let fib : Ds → Fin (2 ^ steps) → D := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := jir) (steps := steps)
      (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
    have hrec : ∀ x, fib (iq x) (kOf x) = x := fun x =>
      (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps (x := x) (y := iq x)).mp rfl
    rw [show hammingDist f g' = Δ.card from rfl, hgd]
    calc Δ.card ≤ ((Y.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.univ).image (fun p => fib p.1 p.2)).card :=
        Finset.card_le_card (by intro x hx; exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(iq x, kOf x),
          ⟨Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.1 hx).2⟩,
            Finset.mem_univ _⟩, hrec x⟩⟩)
      _ ≤ (Y.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.univ).card := Finset.card_image_le
      _ = Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
        simp only [Finset.card_product, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
          ← Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
  have h_bridge : Code.distFromCode f C_i ≤ (d_fw * 2 ^ steps : ℕ) :=
    (distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g' hg').trans (ENat.coe_le_coe.mpr h_count)
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_bridge (ENat.coe_le_coe.mpr (Nat.zero_le 2)))
    (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h_fin (Nat.sub_lt_self Nat.one_pos h_pos)))

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intros P_i f_i f_ip1 nc P_ip1 y
  let fib := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (y := y)
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hd : (fib 1 : L) = (fib 0 : L) + 1 := by
    let ii : Fin r := ⟨i, by omega⟩
    have hii : (ii : ℕ) < ℓ + 𝓡 := by show (i : ℕ) < ℓ + 𝓡; omega
    let jj : Fin r := ⟨↑i + 1, by omega⟩
    let b₀ : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ii :=
      sDomain_basis 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ii hii ⟨0, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hii⟩
    let z : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ii :=
      sDomain.lift 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ii) (j := jj) (h_j := h_i_succ_lt)
        (h_le := Nat.le_add_right (i : ℕ) 1) y
    have c₀ : fib 0 = (0 : 𝔽q) • b₀ + z := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have c₁ : fib 1 = (1 : 𝔽q) • b₀ + z := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    have hb : (b₀ : L) = 1 := get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ii hii
    have h1 : (fib 1 : L) = (b₀ : L) + (z : L) := by rw [c₁, one_smul]; rfl
    have h0 : (fib 0 : L) = (z : L) := by rw [c₀, zero_smul, zero_add]
    rw [h1, h0, hb]
    ring
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fib k : L) = (y : L) := by
    have h1 : y = iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (k := 1) (h_bound := by omega) (fib k) :=
      generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega) (fib k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have h2 := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fib k)
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val (h1.trans h2)).symm
  have hsp (k : Fin 2) :
      P_i.eval (fib k : L) = P₀.eval (y : L) + (fib k : L) * P₁.eval (y : L) := by
    rw [show P_i = P₀.comp (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩) +
        Polynomial.X * P₁.comp (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩) from
        evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp,
      hq k]
  have hA : f_ip1 y = P_i.eval (fib 0 : L) * ((1 - r_chal) * (fib 1 : L) - r_chal) +
      P_i.eval (fib 1 : L) * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * (fib 0 : L)) := by
    dsimp only [f_ip1, Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold, f_i]
  have hP : P_ip1 = Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    dsimp only [P_ip1, P₀, P₁]
    simp only [intermediateEvaluationPoly, evenRefinement, oddRefinement]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    simp only [nc, Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, Polynomial.C_sub, Polynomial.C_1]
    ring
  have hcalc : f_ip1 y = (1 - r_chal) * P₀.eval (y : L) + r_chal * P₁.eval (y : L) := by
    rw [hA, hsp 0, hsp 1, hd]
    ring
  have h₂ := congrArg (fun p : L[X] => p.eval (y : L)) hP
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C] at h₂
  exact hcalc.trans h₂.symm

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ with
  | zero => exact fun h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  | succ ϑ_sub_1 ih =>
    cases ϑ_sub_1 with
    | zero =>
      -- `ϑ = 1`: the multilinear combination of the two rows is an affine line
      simp only [zero_add, zero_lt_one, forall_const]
      intro u hP
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u),
        prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
          (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
        Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hP
      rw [show u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) from by
        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl]
      exact hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hP
    | succ ϑ_sub_2 =>
      -- `ϑ >= 2`: fold the last coin into an affine line between the two half word stacks
      intro _ u hP
      let ϑ' : ℕ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
      let U₀ : WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ')) ι := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ') u).1
      let U₁ : WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ')) ι := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ') u).2
      have hrec (r : Fin (ϑ' + 1) → F) : multilinearCombine u r =
          multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ (r (Fin.last ϑ'))) (fun i => r i.castSucc) :=
        multilinearCombine_recursive_form (ϑ := ϑ') u r
      simp_rw [hrec] at hP
      let R_star_set := R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ') (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁
      have hRstar : Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[r ∈ R_star_set]
          > (ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
        refine prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ϑ := ϑ') (u := u) (e := e) ?_
        rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun (F := F) (ϑ := ϑ')
          (P := multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close (ϑ := ϑ') (MC := MC) (u := u) (e := e))]
        exact hP
      have hline : ∀ (r : R_star_set),
          jointProximityNat (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r.val) (e := e) (C := MC) := by
        intro r
        apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (ih := fun w => ih (Nat.succ_pos _) w) (u := u)
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
      refine h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ ϑ') Nat.one_le_two_pow (⋈|U₀) (⋈|U₁)
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hRstar (Pr_le_Pr_of_implies ($ᵖ F) _ _ fun r hr => hline ⟨r, hr⟩))

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hz : (Set.range f).Finite :=
    .subset (Set.finite_Icc (B, B, B, B) (T, T, T, T))
      (Set.range_subset_iff.mpr (by simp only [mem_Icc, Prod.mk_le_mk, hB, and_self, implies_true, f]))
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, heq⟩ : ∃ i j, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! h
    exact hz.not_infinite (Set.infinite_range_of_injective fun a b e => by
      contrapose! e
      exact (Nat.ne_iff_lt_or_gt.mp e).elim (h a b) fun h2 => (h b a h2).symm)
  have hr : ∀ n, (u (n + 4) : ℝ) = (fun (a, b, c, d) => (d + c + b * a) / (d * c + b + a)) (f n) :=
    fun n => (hu (n + 4) (by omega)).1
  have hp : ∀ m, f (i + m) = f (j + m) := by
    refine Nat.rec heq fun m ih => ?_
    have h4 : u (i + m + 4) = u (j + m + 4) := by
      rw [← Int.cast_inj (α := ℝ), hr, hr, ih]
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq, f] at ih ⊢
    tauto
  refine ⟨i, j - i, by omega, fun n hn => by
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hn
    rw [show i + m + (j - i) = j + m from by omega]
    exact (congrArg Prod.fst (hp m)).symm⟩

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  refine Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left Nat.two_pos ((((Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq (by simpa only [Set.Intersecting, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] using hPP)).mp fun t ht hst =>
    le_antisymm hst fun a ha => by_contra fun h =>
      hPS ⟨a, h, fun u hu hE => ht ha (hst hu) (Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr hE)⟩).trans
    Fintype.card_set).trans ?_)
  rw [← pow_succ', Nat.sub_add_cancel Fintype.card_pos]

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h i
  let w : Fin 9 → ℤ := fun j => (10 : ℤ) ^ (j : ℕ)
  obtain ⟨_, hd⟩ := (hrelation d e).mp h.1
  obtain ⟨_, he⟩ := (hrelation e f).mp h.2
  have rep (u v : Fin 9 → ℤ) (k : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = k then v j else u j) = digits_to_num u + (v k - u k) * w k := by
    rw [← add_comm, ← sub_eq_iff_eq_add]
    simp only [hdigits_to_num]
    rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Fintype.sum_ite_eq' k (fun j => (v j - u j) * w j)]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    by_cases h : j = k
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, sub_mul]; rfl
    · simp only [h, ↓reduceIte, sub_self]
  have h₂ : ∑ k, (digits_to_num d + (e k - d k) * w k)
      = 9 * digits_to_num d + (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d) := by
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_mul,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    rfl
  have h₃ : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * w i := by
    rw [show (d i - f i) * w i = 9 * digits_to_num d + (digits_to_num e - digits_to_num d)
          - 7 * digits_to_num d - (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * w i)
          - (digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * w i) from by ring]
    exact ((h₂ ▸ Finset.dvd_sum fun k _ => (rep d e k) ▸ hd k).sub (dvd_mul_right 7 _)).sub
        ((rep d e i) ▸ hd i) |>.sub ((rep e f i) ▸ he i)
  exact (show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 from ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩).pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right h₃
